title: How Sink Drainage Systems Work
description: Every residential sink relies on a carefully balanced network of gravity, venting, and physical barriers to remove wastewater while blocking sewer gases from entering living spaces. The fundamental component of this setup is the trap, commonly shaped like a 'P', which maintains a constant water seal. When water flows from the basin, it pushes through the trap and enters the horizontal and vertical drain lines. Meanwhile, the vent system allows air to enter the pipes, preventing negative pressure that could otherwise siphon the water seal dry. Grasping this mechanical layout is essential for effective troubleshooting and compliant installation.

Meanwhile, the vent system allows air to enter the pipes, preventing negative pressure that could otherwise siphon the water seal dry. Grasping this mechanical layout is essential for effective troubleshooting and compliant installation.
